statement: The real positive numbers a1 , a2 , a3 are three consecutive terms of an arithmetic progression, and similarly, b1 , b2 , b3 are distinct real positive numbers and consecutive terms of an arithmetic progression. Is it possible to use three segments of lengths a1 , a2 , a3 as bases, and other three segments of lengths b1 , b2 , b3 as altitudes, to construct three rectangles of equal area ?

Let ABC be a triangle with ∠ACB > 90◦ , and let D be a point on BC such that AD is perpendicular to BC. Consider the circumference Γ with with diameter BC. A line ℓ passes through D and is tangent to Γ at P , cuts AC at M (such that M is in between A and C), and cuts the side AB at N . Prove that M is the midpoint of DP if and only if N is the midpoint of AB.

Let m, n ≥ 2 be two integers. In an m × n grid, an ant starts in the lower left square and wants to walk to the upper right square. Each step the ant takes must be to an adjacent square, according to the following possibilities: ↑, →, and ↗. However, an evil wizard has dropped lava from above and destroyed some of the squares, such that: • If a square is destroyed, then all the squares above it are also destroyed. • The number of destroyed squares is greater than or equal to 0. • There are enough undestroyed squares left for the ant to reach its goal. Let P be the number of even-length paths the ant can follow. Let I be the number of odd-length paths the ant can follow. Find the possible values of P − I. Note: The length of a path is the number of steps the ant takes. Determine all non empty sets C1 , C2 , C3 , · · · such that each one of them has a ﬁnite number of elements, all their elements are positive integers, and they satisfy the following property: For any positive integers n and m, the number of elements in the set Cn plus the number of elements in the set Cm equals the sum of the elements in the set Cm+n . Note: We denote |Cn | the number of elements in the set Cn , and Sk as the sum of the elements in the set Cn so the problem’s condition is that for every n and m: |Cn |+|Cm |= Sn+m is satisﬁed.
